{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.56

|gr1= Multiplayer

|gr2= Diagnostic

|descr= Registers new log file recording a network traffic and returns handle of the log. The log file is saved inside the {{arma3}} root folder.
{{Feature|important|[[logNetwork]] can potentially create a large log file.}}

|s1= [[logNetwork]] [logFile, filter]

|p1= logFile: [[String]] - where to store the log

|p2= filter: [[Array]] of [[String]]s - (Optional) ????

|r1= [[Number]] - handle for the logging

|x1= <sqf>_handle = logNetwork ["myLog.txt", [""]];</sqf>

|seealso= [[logNetworkTerminate]]
}}
